scenes.basis: 21:1 "we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara"; 21:2 "Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail" - the ship is found at Patara, the last stop of 21:1
21:3 "we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo"; 21:4 "Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days"
21:7 "When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day"

21:8 "we, who were Paul’s companions, departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist"; 21:10 "As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea"
21:17 "When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly"; 21:18 "Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present"

21:26 "purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification"; 21:27 "the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude"; 21:30 "They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple"

21:31 "news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar"; 21:34 "he commanded him to be brought into the barracks"; 21:40 "Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people"
